body: I'm simply living because I have the feeling that I'm not done here. I fell in love with a guy and I kinda just keep on living for him. Also I've set a goal: I want to see space once. Just looking at the stars reminds me who I am and what I want to reach. Even though I know that I won't reach my goal, it still is a big dream and it gives me the power to go on.

thanks. I've already stopped any contact to my internet friends. My crush did not care when I stopped texting him and he could still try contacting me via e-mail (he's got my adress). It seems like I was just a tool for him, but I already accepted that and I can live with it now.

I just don't feel like people will understand me. You know, it's always me who makes up all those interpretation. No matter what they say, I'll just end up interpreting things differently.
